section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1986
title: ## PART—II ## SUICIDES IN INDIA A total of 54,357 suicides were reported in India during 1986 compared to 52,811 in 1985 registering an increase of 2.9% in 1986 over 1985. The numerical increase registered during 1986 over 1985 was of 1,546 suicidal deaths. The total number of suicidal deaths in India recorded in 1986 was an all-time high during the period of 11 years since 1976.
